newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan textiles rise sharply on bargain hunting.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan textiles rise sharply on bargain hunting.

text.p: Taiwan textile shares rose sharply in late trade on Wednesday as investors hunted for bargains, taking advantage of the relatively low prices in the sector, brokers said.
* At 0350 GMT, the textile sector was up 15.06 points or 3.86 percent at 405.52.
* Brokers said the textile sector had been dormant for several weeks while the rest of the market soared, giving it more room for growth.
* Chen Han-chung, manager of Yungli Securities, said: "Its momentum would not last...as investors are likely to take profits and place their investments in bellwether electronics."

* More than 10 textile shares, including Lily Textile, Lan Fa Textile, Hong Yi Fiber, Li Peng Enterprise, Ruentex Industrial, Lucky Textile and Tong Hwa Synthetics, rose by their daily seven-percent limit.
* Other shares which rose to their limit were Shing Kong Synthetic Fibre, Chung Fu Textile, Chung Shing Textile and Yi Jinh Industrial.
